post.description: One transaction, all or nothing: the stock of every line is reserved (30 minutes by default), the prices are read again, the totals are computed on the server, the order is stored with an immutable snapshot and the cart is emptied. `expectedTotal` is the total the shopper saw; if it differs, or a line became unavailable, the answer is 409 `cart_changed` with the fresh cart and nothing is reserved. A guest gets an `accessToken` once. The same `Idempotency-Key` with the same request returns the same order with 200 (a guest gets the SAME token as in the first answer); with another request it is 409 `idempotency_key_reused`. A customer or a guest email that already holds the most unpaid orders allowed (`MAX_OPEN_ORDERS`, 3 by default) gets 409 `too_many_open_orders` for a new order; a replay is answered even then.

post.description: Starts an online payment attempt for an order that awaits payment (ADR 0032). The amount is the order total read by the server; the body takes no amount or currency (a strict body: any such member is a 400). previousAmount.description: The unit price the shopper last saw (`POST /store/cart/acknowledge` accepts the current one).

code.description: The price rose so that this quantity no longer fits the money limit. The line is unavailable (no price or total, left out of the subtotal); lower the quantity or remove it.

amount.description: Minor units of the shop currency (for example kopiykas).

subtotal.description: Sum of the line totals of the available lines (unavailable lines are left out).

amount.description: Minor units of the shop currency (for example kopiykas).

total.description: Equal to `subtotal` until shipping, discount or tax adjustments exist.

purchasable.description: At least one line and no unavailable line.

requiresShipping.description: Whether the checkout will ask for a shipping address: at least one AVAILABLE line is a physical product (its product type ships goods). Unavailable lines are not counted, because the checkout refuses them before it asks for an address; an empty cart is `false`. Equal to what `POST /store/checkout` enforces (`400 shipping_address_required`) once the cart is purchasable.

cart.description: Only on `cart_changed`: the fresh cart, exactly as `GET /store/cart` returns it.

description.description: The method's description; for `store_pickup` the pickup instructions.

reason.description: Why the method is not available; only when `available` is false.

price.description: What the shop charges for shipping; `null` when not available.

total.description: The cart subtotal plus `price`, computed by the server: send it back as the checkout's `expectedTotal`. `null` when not available.

estimate.description: The carrier's own price, informational only (never charged): only when `cityRef` or `pickupPointRef` is sent and the provider answers in time.

shipping.description: Only on `shipping_changed`: the chosen method's fresh option, exactly as `GET /store/shipping/options` returns it, or `{methodCode, available: false, reason}` when the method is not offered any more.

reason.description: Only on a carrier failure of a shipment route (`shipping_provider_unavailable`, `rule_violation` `carrier_*`): the provider's typed reason.

payment.description: Only on `payment_provider_unavailable` of the store create routes: the attempt (`paymentId`, its shopper `status`) and whether a new attempt is accepted (`canRetry`). With `canRetry` false the provider's answer was lost: wait (`Retry-After`) and read the status instead of starting another attempt.

providerCodes.description: Only on a carrier failure of a shipment route: the raw carrier codes (never message text); may be empty.
